result.text:
These days, I believe polyamory is often a way to cope with an inability to connect deeply with one person, or a way to admit a lack of self-control without necessarily doing the self-development that would make the arrangement ethical.
If you can't do monogamy, saying so is still more honest than pretending you can. If your feelings change, that needs to be sayable too. Sometimes both people know before either one admits it, and the concealment does more damage than an outside connection would have.

text:
These days, I believe polyamory is often a way to cope with an inability to connect deeply with one person, or a way to admit a lack of self-control without necessarily doing the self-development that would make the arrangement ethical.

If you can't do monogamy, saying so is still more honest than pretending you can. If your feelings change, that needs to be sayable too. Sometimes both people know before either one admits it, and the concealment does more damage than an outside connection would have.
